title: Timbits
hookLine: Canadian-inspired timbits with 9 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Timbits
steps.instructionTemplate: Sift together dry ingredients. Sifting aerates the dry ingredients and removes any stubborn cocoa or flour lumps so the finished crumb bakes up light and even. Incorporate {m52929_1}, {m52929_2}, {m52929_3}, and {m52929_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Timbits
steps.instructionTemplate: Mix together wet ingredients and incorporate into dry. Stir until smooth. Combine until completely smooth, uniform, and free of lumps before moving to the next stage. Incorporate {m52929_5}, {m52929_6}, {m52929_7}, {m52929_8}, and {m52929_9} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Timbits
steps.instructionTemplate: Drop by teaspoonfuls(no bigger) into hot oil (365 degrees, no hotter), turning after a few moments until golden brown on all sides.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Timbits
steps.instructionTemplate: Roll in cinnamon sugar while still warm and serve. Drain briefly on a wire cooling rack lined with paper towels for 1–2 minutes so the outside stays shatteringly crisp, then plate into 4 servings and enjoy warm.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
